name: conwy-castle
documented_evidence: Cadw teacher guide provides the scaled castle plan and confirms eight towers, extra turrets on four eastern towers, two wards, royal rooms and roof removal after the Civil War.
modeling_qualifications: Plan positions digitised using30m/160pixels on a1500pixel page image. Local origin is image(450,475), z is upward on plan. Do not restore missing roof ranges.21m main tower height is an approximate secondary dimension; tower plan radii follow scaled outlines. The compass and production north wall both indicate near-east/west axis.
attribution: Original procedural metric mesh; no downloaded mesh or photo textures. Map ring evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps. Operator texts/images are referenced, not redistributed.
